note: Toole County (MT) publishes no queryable zoning district service. The county GIS directory (gismaps.org) links no zoning service and points to Shelby City Hall for zoning boundaries. Shelby's zoning code (13-1-3) says the official zoning map is kept by the city finance officer; the city planning page that once linked an online map returns 404. ArcGIS searches for Toole County and Shelby zoning found nothing; the Frontier Institute zoning atlas layer covers other Montana cities, not Toole. Sunburst, Kevin and the other towns showed no zoning service either.
